main_text.p: שָׂא, vel שָׂא tolle, שְׂאוּ tollite, שְׂאֵנִי me, Im-per. Kal, f. m. & pl. m, aff. R. נָשָׂא.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and the Rad. forms are copied from a small, heavily speckled scan and may be wrong, especially רָקְקָ, רִיר, the reading of the second line of the right column and the vowels after שָׂא. The bottom-right head "ש א" and the entries beside it are marked as a letter heading. The "3. pl" line at the far lower right is a continuation of "vastantur, præt. Kal, 3. pl." and is printed in that position. No catchword or signature is printed.
